cross_run_aggregate_read.reason: The ledger's runners project to id-stubs only, so it can never serve as the domain-keyed state read; it is an audit-only cross-run aggregate. The domain-keyed read is the data-store read_projection above.

findings.norm: Refusal spike norm health_baseline.refusal_spike_rate 0.15: an implied refusal rate at or below 0.15 is healthy, so a seal rate at or above 0.85 is the norm.
findings.detail: 24 of 34 folded turns sealed; the implied refusal rate 0.29 is above the 0.15 refusal_spike_rate norm.

findings.norm: health_baseline.threshold_days_stuck 3: a case whose latest folded turn has not advanced for more than 3 days is stuck. The norm is zero stuck cases.
findings.detail: case:acme-support:1042 has not advanced past turn 4 in 9 days and case:acme-support:1061 has not advanced past turn 3 in 5 days; both exceed the 3-day threshold.

findings.norm: health_baseline.cap_pressure_pct 80: sustained cap usage above 80 percent of the agency charter's granted cap is cap pressure.
findings.detail: Folded spend against the agency charter cap is at 93 percent, above the 80 percent cap_pressure_pct norm. The remedy widens a cap, so it escalates to the human ops lane rather than routing as a routine tighten.

findings.norm: An escalation is expected to be picked up within the same period it is raised, so the norm is an empty backlog at period close.
findings.detail: 3 escalations raised in the folded projection are still unclaimed at period close; the oldest is 9 days old.

intervention_findings.finding: Two cases are stuck past the 3-day threshold with no advancing turn, and the implied refusal rate 0.29 is nearly double the 0.15 norm.
intervention_findings.reason: Stuck turns concentrated behind repeated refusals are a skill-behavior defect, which is the improve-skill lane's subject.
intervention_findings.consumed_by: Nothing here. A downstream driver or operator must issue a separate improve-skill run to act on this finding.

intervention_findings.finding: Cap usage is at 93 percent of the agency charter cap, above the 80 percent norm, and the plausible remedy widens the cap.
intervention_findings.reason: A cap-widening remedy widens authority and this finding is graded critical, so it escalates to the human ops lane instead of routing as a routine tighten.
intervention_findings.consumed_by: Nothing here. The human ops lane decides; this skill only reports.

intervention_findings.finding: 3 escalations are unclaimed at period close, the oldest 9 days old, so the routing policy is not draining the backlog.
intervention_findings.reason: An escalation backlog is a routing-policy defect, which is the policy-author lane's subject. No cap or authority is widened by re-routing, so it does not escalate to human ops.
intervention_findings.consumed_by: Nothing here. A separate policy-author run must be issued to change routing.
